## NexusErroresMapeo
Errores de mapeo de los adaptadores (sin timeouts 504). pctServicioCanal = total / respuestas del servicio en ese canal; pctCanal = total / respuestas de todo el canal. Query en OpenSearch SQL. Volver: [NexusGeneral](#dashboards:name=NexusGeneral)

properties.query:
SELECT e.codigo, e.mensaje, e.campo, e.service, e.channel, e.total,
  ROUND(e.total * 100.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN r.service = e.service THEN r.respuestas ELSE 0 END), 4) AS pctServicioCanal,
  ROUND(e.total * 100.0 / SUM(r.respuestas), 4) AS pctCanal
FROM (
  SELECT regexp_extract(`@message`, 'Exception:[ ]*([0-9]+)[ ]*::', 1) AS codigo, regexp_extract(`@message`, 'Exception:[ ]*[0-9]+[ ]*::[ ]*([^.]*[^. ])', 1) AS mensaje, regexp_extract(`@message`, '3=([A-Za-z0-9_.]+)[ ]*::HEAD::', 1) AS campo,
    regexp_extract(`@message`, 'X-Referer=[^-,]+-[^-,]+-[^-,]+-([A-Za-z0-9_]+)', 1) AS service, regexp_extract(`@message`, 'X-Name=([A-Za-z0-9_]+)', 1) AS channel, COUNT(*) AS total
  FROM `logGroups(logGroupIdentifier: ['/aws/ecs/srv/accountsws-iseries-adapter', '/aws/ecs/srv/accountsws-stratus-adapter', '/aws/ecs/srv/acquiringws-stratus-adapter', '/aws/ecs/srv/clientsws-stratus-adapter', '/aws/ecs/srv/credit-cardsws-iseries-adapter', '/aws/ecs/srv/credit-cardsws-postilion-adapter', '/aws/ecs/srv/credit-cardsws-stratus-adapter', '/aws/ecs/srv/insurancesws-stratus-adapter', '/aws/ecs/srv/investmentsws-stratus-adapter', '/aws/ecs/srv/loansws-stratus-adapter', '/aws/ecs/srv/paymentsws-iseries-adapter', '/aws/ecs/srv/paymentsws-stratus-adapter', '/aws/ecs/srv/productsws-stratus-adapter', '/aws/ecs/srv/remittancesws-stratus-adapter', '/aws/ecs/srv/securityws-stratus-adapter'])`
  WHERE `@message` LIKE '%GenericExceptionMapper%' AND `@message` LIKE '%HttpCode::%' AND regexp_extract(`@message`, 'Exception:[ ]*([0-9]+)[ ]*::', 1) <> '504'
  GROUP BY regexp_extract(`@message`, 'Exception:[ ]*([0-9]+)[ ]*::', 1), regexp_extract(`@message`, 'Exception:[ ]*[0-9]+[ ]*::[ ]*([^.]*[^. ])', 1), regexp_extract(`@message`, '3=([A-Za-z0-9_.]+)[ ]*::HEAD::', 1), regexp_extract(`@message`, 'X-Referer=[^-,]+-[^-,]+-[^-,]+-([A-Za-z0-9_]+)', 1), regexp_extract(`@message`, 'X-Name=([A-Za-z0-9_]+)', 1)
) AS e
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT regexp_extract(`@message`, 'X-Referer=[^-,]+-[^-,]+-[^-,]+-([A-Za-z0-9_]+)', 1) AS service, regexp_extract(`@message`, 'X-Name=([A-Za-z0-9_]+)', 1) AS channel, COUNT(*) AS respuestas
  FROM `logGroups(logGroupIdentifier: ['/aws/ecs/srv/accountsws-iseries-adapter', '/aws/ecs/srv/accountsws-stratus-adapter', '/aws/ecs/srv/acquiringws-stratus-adapter', '/aws/ecs/srv/clientsws-stratus-adapter', '/aws/ecs/srv/credit-cardsws-iseries-adapter', '/aws/ecs/srv/credit-cardsws-postilion-adapter', '/aws/ecs/srv/credit-cardsws-stratus-adapter', '/aws/ecs/srv/insurancesws-stratus-adapter', '/aws/ecs/srv/investmentsws-stratus-adapter', '/aws/ecs/srv/loansws-stratus-adapter', '/aws/ecs/srv/paymentsws-iseries-adapter', '/aws/ecs/srv/paymentsws-stratus-adapter', '/aws/ecs/srv/productsws-stratus-adapter', '/aws/ecs/srv/remittancesws-stratus-adapter', '/aws/ecs/srv/securityws-stratus-adapter'])`
  WHERE `@message` LIKE '%::AUDIT::RESP::%'
  GROUP BY regexp_extract(`@message`, 'X-Referer=[^-,]+-[^-,]+-[^-,]+-([A-Za-z0-9_]+)', 1), regexp_extract(`@message`, 'X-Name=([A-Za-z0-9_]+)', 1)
) AS r ON r.channel = e.channel
GROUP BY e.codigo, e.mensaje, e.campo, e.service, e.channel, e.total
ORDER BY e.total DESC
LIMIT 1000
properties.title: ERRORES DE MAPEO POR TIPO (% sobre respuestas del servicio y del canal)
